description: Try-each counts the variants whose types decode a value, so it takes a oneOf only where each variant's type checks what can rule the variant out. checked: the not of Unfiled, an object declared on its own, forbids a property, which its struct checks, so the oneOf is tried. inline: a variant written inline is generated as a copy, which checks no not of its own; tried, {"file": "x"} would match both variants and be rejected as ambiguous. merged: a variant whose allOf merges checks no not beside it either. Neither is tried.
